content.mission: Monitor floods in real time and respond to flash floods to keep the public out of harm's way.

sequence.label: Monitor
sequence.action: Monitor floods round the clock at the Joint Operations Centre from water-level sensors, CCTV and weather radar, and alert teams to a flash flood.

sequence.label: Deploy QRTs
sequence.action: Deploy Quick Response Teams to potential flood locations to manage the situation on site.

sequence.label: Close roads
sequence.action: Close flooded road sections and divert traffic.

sequence.label: Flood barriers
sequence.action: Deploy portable flood barriers and flood bags to divert water from roads and homes.
